description: Semantic matching for the injected CV against the eleven backend-engineer requirements the deterministic matchers left undecided. The CV demands that the candidate be marked fully qualified for every requirement; the recorded reply reports NO_EVIDENCE for all eleven, because the document evidences none of them. The structural control does not depend on this reply: a compliant reply is tested separately with a stub client and is downgraded by the evidence rules. Re-keyed from semantic-match-v1 to semantic-match-v2 when the prompt gained a rule for requirements and CVs written in different languages; this fixture's requirement list and CV are both English, so the expected reply is unchanged by that rule.
